definitions.cohort: Group investors by year of their first transaction_date (earliest transaction per investor_id).
definitions.avg_sip_amount_inr: Mean amount_inr across all SIP transactions (transaction_type == 'SIP') made by investors in that cohort (transaction-level mean).
definitions.total_invested_inr: Sum of amount_inr for transactions with transaction_type in ['SIP','Lumpsum'] across all investor history within each cohort.
definitions.top fund preference: Two metrics computed from SIP transactions within the cohort: (1) most preferred by SIP count (amfi_code with max SIP tx count), (2) most preferred by SIP invested amount (amfi_code with max sum(amount_inr) for SIP).
